articles.title: China’s 1MW perovskite solar farm beats silicon system in industrial-scale test
articles.summary: China's groundbreaking 1MW perovskite solar farm has outperformed traditional silicon systems in industrial-scale tests, marking a pivotal advancement toward the commercialization of low-cost, high-efficiency solar panels that could revolutionize the renewable energy landscape. This achievement, driven by a collaborative effort from researchers at Nanjing University and Canadian partners, introduces a super-stable coating that addresses critical defects in perovskite technology, potentially transforming solar energy production.

articles.title: Global leaders must wake up to threat of unbridled AI adoption
articles.summary: The article warns that the unchecked adoption of artificial intelligence poses a grave risk, highlighting the urgent need for responsible leadership to navigate its potential benefits and dangers, particularly in Western nations. This critical juncture could determine whether AI serves as a catalyst for global prosperity or a source of unprecedented challenges.

articles.title: Open-weight Chinese AI models gain foothold in Europe despite Brussels’ trepidation
articles.summary: Chinese open-weight AI models are making significant inroads in Europe, prompting businesses to reconsider their reliance on proprietary US technologies; this shift could enhance operational control while challenging the continent's technological sovereignty.
